title: 台灣同步輻射光源 TLS~Taiwan Light Source
focus: 1.5 GeV、120 m TBA 儲存環的能量提升、超導插件、超導射頻、頂注穩定、地層監測與雙光源分工~Energy upgrade, superconducting insertion devices, SRF, top-up stability, ground monitoring and dual-source division in a 1.5 GeV, 120 m TBA ring
summary: 以 TLS 的 18 台偶極（ρ = 3.495 m）與 1.3 → 1.5 GeV 的能量提升為起點，理解這座亞洲第一座第三代光源如何用 6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光，再把 CESR 型超導射頻、每 60 s 的頂注、TPS 施工期間的地層監測與軟 X 光波盪器整合成與 TPS 並行運轉的工程交接。~Starting from TLS's 18 dipoles (ρ = 3.495 m) and its 1.3 → 1.5 GeV energy upgrade, see how Asia's first third-generation source used a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers to push a 1.5 GeV ring into hard X-rays, then integrate the CESR-type SRF cavity, 60 s top-up, ground monitoring during TPS construction and soft-X-ray undulators into a handoff for operation alongside TPS.

units.anchor: 18 台偶極磁鐵（ρ = 3.495 m）~18 dipoles with ρ = 3.495 m
units.title: 1.5 GeV 偶極輻射與能量提升~1.5 GeV dipole radiation and the energy upgrade
units.mechanism: TLS 是周長 120 m 的電子儲存環，由 6 個三彎消色散（TBA）超週期、共 18 台偶極磁鐵組成，彎轉半徑 3.495 m。它原本以 1.3 GeV、1.24 T 設計並於 1993 年啟用，1996 年起把運轉能量提升到 1.5 GeV；由於 ρ 固定，偶極場必須按比例升到約 1.43 T，鐵芯更接近飽和。能量提升使臨界能量按 E³ 上升、每圈輻射損失按 E⁴ 上升，光譜往較硬的 X 光延伸，代價是射頻功率與真空熱負載同步增加。~TLS is an electron storage ring of 120 m circumference built from six triple-bend-achromat (TBA) superperiods with 18 dipoles of 3.495 m bending radius. Designed for 1.3 GeV at 1.24 T and opened in 1993, it moved to 1.5 GeV operation from 1996; with ρ fixed, the dipole field had to rise proportionally to about 1.43 T, closer to iron saturation. The upgrade raises the critical energy as E³ and the energy loss per turn as E⁴, extending the spectrum to harder X-rays at the price of more RF power and vacuum heat load.
units.model: 能量提升時磁場、臨界能量與每圈損失的連鎖變化：Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m，B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T（1.3 GeV 時 1.24 T）。E_c = 2.218E³/ρ ≈ 2.14 keV（1.3 GeV 時 1.39 keV）；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ ≈ 128 keV（1.3 GeV 時 72 keV，增加 77%）；360 mA 時偶極輻射功率 ≈ 128 keV×0.36 A ≈ 46 kW。~Chain of changes with energy: Bρ = 3.3356×1.5 = 5.003 T·m and B = 5.003/3.495 ≈ 1.43 T (1.24 T at 1.3 GeV). E_c = 2.218E³/ρ ≈ 2.14 keV (1.39 keV at 1.3 GeV); U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ ≈ 128 keV (72 keV at 1.3 GeV, 77% more); at 360 mA the dipole radiation power is ≈ 128 keV×0.36 A ≈ 46 kW.
units.verify: 量測射頻前向減反射功率並扣除腔損，與 I×(U₀ + 插件損失) 比較；以偶極光束線單色器掃描光譜，確認高能尾端斜率符合 2.14 keV 臨界能量的通用曲線，間接核對束流能量；以磁場量測確認 1.43 T 運轉點的積分場與多極成分。~Measure RF forward minus reflected power less cavity loss and compare with I×(U₀ + insertion-device loss); scan a bending-magnet beamline spectrum with its monochromator and check that the high-energy tail matches the universal curve for a 2.14 keV critical energy, an indirect check of beam energy; confirm integrated field and multipoles at the 1.43 T operating point by magnetic measurement.
units.failure: 能量提升後若未重新評估偶極的飽和與多極場，六極成分改變色品與動力孔徑，注入效率與壽命下降；光子吸收器若仍按 1.3 GeV 的熱負載設計，局部過熱造成壓力上升，所有光束線同時受影響。~If dipole saturation and multipoles are not re-evaluated after the upgrade, a changed sextupole component alters chromaticity and dynamic aperture, lowering injection efficiency and lifetime; photon absorbers still designed for 1.3 GeV heat loads overheat locally, pressure rises and every beamline suffers.
units.misconception: 能量只提高 15%，同步輻射功率也只增加約 15%。~Raising energy by 15% raises synchrotron-radiation power by only about 15%.

units.anchor: 六重對稱 TBA 晶格~Six-fold TBA lattice
units.title: TBA 發射度與 TPS 的世代比較~TBA emittance and the generational comparison with TPS
units.mechanism: 第三代光源的關鍵是用消色散晶格壓低發射度，並把插件磁鐵放在零色散的直線段。TLS 每個超週期用三台偶極，6 段約 6 m 長的直線段供插件、射頻與注入使用；設計發射度在 1.3 GeV 為 19.2 nm·rad，按 E² 標度在 1.5 GeV 約 25.6 nm·rad，公開資料依運轉光學列 22 至 25 nm·rad。發射度隨 γ²θ³ 與晶格因子 F 標度：TLS 每台偶極彎 20°，TPS 每台只彎 7.5° 且能量加倍，兩者的發射度相差約 16 倍。設計工作點 7.18／4.13、動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³。~The key to a third-generation source is an achromatic lattice that lowers emittance and places insertion devices in dispersion-free straights. TLS uses three dipoles per superperiod and six straights of about 6 m for insertion devices, RF and injection; the design emittance of 19.2 nm·rad at 1.3 GeV scales as E² to about 25.6 nm·rad at 1.5 GeV, with public values of 22 to 25 nm·rad depending on the operating optics. Emittance scales with γ²θ³ and a lattice factor F: each TLS dipole bends 20° while each TPS dipole bends only 7.5° at twice the energy, and their emittances differ by about 16 times. Design tunes are 7.18/4.13 and the momentum compaction is 6.78×10⁻³.
units.model: ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³。γ²θ³ 比（TLS/TPS）= (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74；實際比 25.6/1.6 = 16，表示 TLS 的晶格因子 F ≈ 0.18、TPS ≈ 0.054，相差約 3.4 倍，其餘差距來自晶格世代而非能量與彎角。以 1.3 GeV 設計值換算：19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad。~ε = F·C_q·γ²θ³. The γ²θ³ ratio (TLS/TPS) is (1.5/3)²×(48/18)³ ≈ 0.25×18.96 ≈ 4.74, while the actual ratio is 25.6/1.6 = 16, so TLS has F ≈ 0.18 and TPS F ≈ 0.054, about 3.4 times apart; the remaining gap comes from lattice generation rather than energy and bend angle. Scaling the 1.3 GeV design value: 19.2×(1.5/1.3)² ≈ 25.6 nm·rad.
units.verify: 以軌道響應矩陣擬合求實際 β 與色散，再用 X 光針孔或可見光干涉儀量束流尺寸，按 ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β 反推並與 25 nm·rad 比較；改變射頻頻率量測軌道對能量的響應，以驗證動量壓縮因子 6.78×10⁻³；量測工作點並與 7.18／4.13 的設計值比較。~Fit the orbit-response matrix for actual beta and dispersion, measure beam size with an X-ray pinhole or visible-light interferometer and invert ε = (σ² − (D·σ_δ)²)/β for comparison with 25 nm·rad; measure the orbit response to RF-frequency steps to verify the 6.78×10⁻³ momentum compaction; measure the tunes against the 7.18/4.13 design.
units.failure: 插件磁鐵開啟後的聚焦誤差破壞 TBA 的消色散條件，直線段色散不再為零，有效光源尺寸擴大、亮度下降；若只量水平束流尺寸而不扣除色散項，發射度會被高估並誤導晶格調整方向。~Focusing errors from insertion devices break the TBA achromat condition, dispersion appears in the straights, the effective source grows and brightness falls; measuring horizontal beam size without subtracting the dispersion term overestimates emittance and steers lattice tuning the wrong way.
units.misconception: 能量較低的 TLS，發射度一定比 3 GeV 的 TPS 小。~Because TLS has lower energy, its emittance must be smaller than that of 3 GeV TPS.

units.anchor: 6 T 超導波長位移器與超導扭擺器~6 T wavelength shifter and superconducting wigglers
units.title: 超導插件：把 1.5 GeV 環推向硬 X 光~Superconducting insertion devices push a 1.5 GeV ring to hard X-rays
units.mechanism: 1.5 GeV 環的偶極臨界能量只有 2.14 keV，硬 X 光通量不足；TLS 的解法是局部提高磁場：2002 年起運轉的 6 T 超導波長位移器（SWLS）、3.2 T 的 SW6 超導扭擺器，以及安裝在消色散段內、不佔用直線段的 3.1 T 超導扭擺器 IASW（週期 61 mm、16 極、長 960 mm、極間隙 19 mm）。臨界能量正比於 E²B，6 T 磁場把同一環的臨界能量提高約 4 倍。這些插件浸在 4.5 K 液氦中，啟用時需以四極補償工作點偏移，並評估它們對發射度與能量分散的影響。~A 1.5 GeV ring's dipoles give a critical energy of only 2.14 keV and little hard-X-ray flux; TLS raised the field locally instead: a 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter (SWLS) operating since 2002, the 3.2 T SW6 superconducting wiggler, and the 3.1 T in-achromat superconducting wiggler IASW (61 mm period, 16 poles, 960 mm long, 19 mm pole gap), which sits inside the achromat without using a straight. Critical energy scales as E²B, so 6 T raises it about fourfold on the same ring. These devices are immersed in 4.5 K liquid helium, and switching them on requires quadrupole compensation of the tune shift and assessment of their effect on emittance and energy spread.
units.model: 插件磁鐵的臨界能量與磁場成正比，E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B：SWLS 6 T → 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV；SW6 3.2 T → 4.79 keV；IASW 3.1 T → 4.64 keV。IASW 每圈額外損失 ΔU = 0.633E²⟨B²⟩L = 0.633×2.25×(3.1²/2)×0.96 ≈ 6.57 keV，300 mA 時功率 ≈ 1.97 kW；K = 0.934×3.1×6.1 ≈ 17.7，水平扇角 ±K/γ = ±17.7/2935 ≈ ±6.0 mrad。~An insertion device's critical energy is proportional to its field, E_c[keV] = 0.665E²B: the 6 T SWLS gives 0.665×2.25×6 ≈ 8.98 keV, the 3.2 T SW6 4.79 keV and the 3.1 T IASW 4.64 keV. The IASW adds ΔU = 0.633E²⟨B²⟩L = 0.633×2.25×(3.1²/2)×0.96 ≈ 6.57 keV per turn, about 1.97 kW at 300 mA; K = 0.934×3.1×6.1 ≈ 17.7, and the horizontal fan is ±K/γ = ±17.7/2935 ≈ ±6.0 mrad.
units.verify: IASW 勵磁斜坡時同步記錄工作點與軌道，確認四極補償表把工作點偏移壓回；量測扭擺器光束線在 5 至 23 keV 的通量並與偶極比較（文獻報告 15 keV 約為偶極的 500 倍）；監測液氦消耗（約 2.5 L/h）、真空與失超紀錄，作為低溫負載的驗收依據。~Log tunes and orbit while ramping the IASW to confirm that the quadrupole compensation table restores the tunes; measure wiggler-beamline flux from 5 to 23 keV against a bending magnet (about 500 times at 15 keV was reported); monitor liquid-helium consumption (about 2.5 L/h), vacuum and quench records as the cryogenic-load acceptance.
units.failure: IASW 的磁鐵中心若未相對理想軌道偏移足夠距離，同步光打到冷壁，熱負載使液氦蒸發加速甚至失超；SWLS 每圈 13.9 keV 的額外損失改變阻尼與能量分散，若晶格未重新匹配，束流尺寸擴大，所有光束線的亮度一起下降。~If the IASW magnet centre is not offset far enough from the ideal orbit, synchrotron light strikes the cold wall, accelerating helium boil-off or quenching the magnet; the SWLS's extra 13.9 keV per turn changes damping and energy spread, and without lattice rematching the beam grows and brightness falls on every beamline.
units.misconception: 超導扭擺器只是讓光變亮，對儲存環的束流動力學沒有影響。~A superconducting wiggler only brightens the light and leaves ring beam dynamics untouched.

units.anchor: CESR 型 500 MHz 超導腔~CESR-type 500 MHz SRF cavity
units.title: 超導射頻升級、高次模與束流負載~SRF upgrade, higher-order modes and beam loading
units.mechanism: TLS 原本使用銅製 Doris 腔，其高次模與束流相互作用引起耦合束團不穩定，限制了儲存電流。2004 年底改裝以 Cornell CESR-III 設計為基礎、由 ACCEL 製造的單 cell 鈮超導腔，2005 年 2 月起例行運轉：超導腔可用大口徑束管讓高次模傳出腔外吸收，並以單一腔提供足夠電壓。配合 100 kW 速調管發射機，電流由 200 mA 提升到 300 mA，再到 360 mA；但高電流下束流負載很重，低階射頻迴路需精細調整才能穩定。~TLS originally used copper Doris cavities whose higher-order modes drove coupled-bunch instabilities that capped the stored current. At the end of 2004 it installed a single-cell niobium cavity based on Cornell's CESR-III design and built by ACCEL, in routine use from February 2005: the superconducting cavity can use large beam pipes that let higher-order modes escape to absorbers, and one cavity supplies enough voltage. With a 100 kW klystron transmitter the current rose from 200 mA to 300 mA and later 360 mA, but beam loading at high current is heavy and the low-level RF loops needed careful tuning to stay stable.
units.model: 束流負載參數 Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c。假設 (R/Q) = 44.5 Ω（電路定義）、Q_L = 2.3×10⁵、V_c = 1.5 MV、I₀ = 0.3 A：Y = 2×0.3×44.5×2.3×10⁵/1.5×10⁶ ≈ 4.1，與文獻報告 300 mA 時的 4.2 一致。功率：U₀ 128 keV 加插件約 40 keV（假設）= 168 keV，360 mA 時束流功率 ≈ 61 kW，100 kW 速調管仍有餘裕。~The beam-loading parameter is Y = 2I₀(R/Q)Q_L/V_c. Assuming (R/Q) = 44.5 Ω (circuit definition), Q_L = 2.3×10⁵, V_c = 1.5 MV and I₀ = 0.3 A, Y = 2×0.3×44.5×2.3×10⁵/1.5×10⁶ ≈ 4.1, consistent with the reported 4.2 at 300 mA. Power: U₀ of 128 keV plus about 40 keV from insertion devices (assumed) is 168 keV, about 61 kW of beam power at 360 mA, leaving margin on the 100 kW klystron.
units.verify: 以網路分析儀與束流頻譜量測高次模頻率與阻尼後的品質因數，確認沒有落在束流頻譜線上；量測腔失諧角對束流電流的關係，與 Y 的預測比較；統計射頻跳脫率（2005 年約每週一次，目標每月少於一次）作為可用度驗收指標。~Measure higher-order-mode frequencies and damped quality factors with a network analyser and the beam spectrum, confirming none sits on a beam line; measure cavity detuning versus beam current and compare with the Y prediction; track the RF trip rate (about one per week in 2005, target under one per month) as the availability acceptance metric.
units.failure: 高束流負載下若直接回授與調諧迴路增益不匹配，腔電壓與相位振盪，束流出現縱向振盪甚至 Robinson 不穩定而掉束；低溫系統壓力波動使腔頻率漂移，調諧器追蹤不及也會造成跳脫。~Under heavy beam loading, mismatched direct-feedback and tuner-loop gains make cavity voltage and phase oscillate, and the beam develops longitudinal oscillation or even Robinson instability and is lost; cryogenic pressure fluctuations shift the cavity frequency, and a tuner that cannot follow also causes trips.
units.misconception: 改用超導腔只是為了省電，對束流穩定性沒有幫助。~The switch to an SRF cavity was only about saving power, not beam stability.

units.anchor: 直流電流變壓器與頂注閘控~DCCT and top-up gating
units.title: 頂注運轉的電流穩定度與壽命推算~Top-up current stability and lifetime inference
units.mechanism: TLS 於 2005 年 10 月由衰減模式改為頂注運轉：約每 60 s 由全能量增能環補注一次，使儲存電流維持在 ±0.25% 之內，光束線熱負載近乎恆定，光學元件不再隨電流衰減而漂移。量測核心是直流電流變壓器（DCCT），它的解析度與零點漂移決定能否分辨 0.1% 等級的電流變化，並用來推算壽命與每次補注的電荷。補注瞬間踢擊磁鐵造成的擾動以閘控訊號通知用戶，讓實驗資料可排除注入時段。~TLS moved from decay mode to top-up in October 2005: about every 60 s the full-energy booster tops up the ring, holding stored current within ±0.25%, so beamline heat loads stay nearly constant and optics no longer drift with decaying current. The key measurement is the DC current transformer (DCCT), whose resolution and zero drift determine whether 0.1%-level current changes can be seen and which is used to infer lifetime and the charge per top-up. The kicker disturbance at each injection is announced to users by a gating signal so experiments can exclude those intervals.
units.model: 若每 60 s 正好用完 ±0.25% 的帶寬（ΔI/I = 0.5%），等效壽命 τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h。300 mA 時每次補注 ΔI = 1.5 mA，迴轉週期 T₀ = 120 m/c ≈ 0.400 µs，電荷 ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ ≈ 0.60 nC，約 3.7×10⁹ 個電子。~If each 60 s interval uses the full ±0.25% band (ΔI/I = 0.5%), the equivalent lifetime is τ = Δt/(ΔI/I) = 60/0.005 = 1.2×10⁴ s ≈ 3.3 h. At 300 mA each top-up adds ΔI = 1.5 mA; with revolution period T₀ = 120 m/c ≈ 0.400 µs the charge is ΔQ = ΔI·T₀ ≈ 0.60 nC, about 3.7×10⁹ electrons.
units.verify: 以校正線圈通入已知電流檢查 DCCT 的刻度與零點漂移，並與注入線積分電流變壓器比對注入效率；在暫停補注的時段擬合電流指數衰減求 τ，於不同束團填充模式與垂直發射度下重複量測，分辨 Touschek 與殘氣的貢獻。~Pass a known current through a calibration winding to check DCCT scale and zero drift, and compare with the injection-line integrating transformer to obtain injection efficiency; fit the exponential current decay during a pause in top-up to obtain τ, repeating under different fill patterns and vertical emittances to separate Touschek and residual-gas contributions.
units.failure: 注入凸軌不完全閉合時，每次補注都讓儲存束流振盪數毫秒，光束線看到週期性的強度尖峰；DCCT 零點漂移 0.5 mA 而未校正時，頂注控制把電流維持在錯誤的值，用戶以電流歸一化的數據出現系統誤差。~An imperfectly closed injection bump makes the stored beam oscillate for milliseconds at every top-up, and beamlines see periodic intensity spikes; an uncorrected 0.5 mA DCCT zero drift makes top-up regulate to the wrong current, introducing systematic error into user data normalized by current.
units.misconception: 實施頂注以後，束流壽命就不再重要。~With top-up running, beam lifetime no longer matters.

units.anchor: 流體靜力水準系統與精密傾斜儀~Hydrostatic levelling and precision inclinometers
units.title: TPS 施工期間的地層變形監測~Ground-deformation monitoring during TPS construction
units.mechanism: TPS 緊鄰 TLS 興建，開挖與基礎施工會造成地層沉陷與傾斜；若 TLS 的四極磁鐵隨地面移動數十微米，閉合軌道誤差就會被放大到與束流尺寸同量級。NSRRC 在 TLS 儲存環與光束線安裝流體靜力水準系統（HLS）與 Leica Nivel 220 精密傾斜儀，持續記錄垂直沉陷與地板傾斜，作為 TLS 能否維持正常運轉的判據，也讓軌道回授與重新對準有量化依據。~TPS was built right next to TLS, and excavation and foundation work cause ground settlement and tilt; if TLS quadrupoles move tens of micrometres with the floor, closed-orbit errors are amplified to the scale of the beam size. NSRRC installed a hydrostatic levelling system (HLS) and Leica Nivel 220 precision inclinometers in the TLS storage ring and beamlines to record vertical settlement and floor tilt continuously, providing the criterion for keeping TLS in normal operation and a quantitative basis for orbit feedback and realignment.
units.model: 單一四極垂直位移 Δ 造成的軌道 y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ。假設 β_q = 10 m、量測點 β = 5 m、KL = 0.5 m⁻¹、ν_y = 4.13：係數 ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45，Δ = 10 µm 時軌道約 45 µm；以垂直發射度 88 pm·rad、β_y = 5 m 估得 σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm，擾動約為束流尺寸的 2 倍。~A single quadrupole moved vertically by Δ produces y ≈ √(β_qβ)/(2|sin πν|)·KL·Δ. Assuming β_q = 10 m, β = 5 m at the observation point, KL = 0.5 m⁻¹ and ν_y = 4.13, the factor is ≈ 7.07/(2×0.399)×0.5 ≈ 4.45, so Δ = 10 µm gives about 45 µm of orbit; with 88 pm·rad vertical emittance and β_y = 5 m, σ_y = √(88×10⁻¹²×5) ≈ 21 µm, so the disturbance is about twice the beam size.
units.verify: 把 HLS 與傾斜儀的時間序列和 BPM 軌道、修正磁鐵電流做相關分析，找出沉陷與軌道變化的對應；以施工日誌（開挖、灌漿、重機進出）標記事件；每次停機以雷射追蹤儀複測磁鐵高程，與 HLS 推算值比較。~Correlate HLS and inclinometer time series with BPM orbits and corrector currents to map settlement onto orbit change; tag events from the construction log (excavation, concrete pours, heavy machinery); at each shutdown re-survey magnet heights with a laser tracker and compare with HLS-derived values.
units.failure: 只依賴軌道回授而不監測地面，修正磁鐵電流在數月間逐漸用盡行程，某天回授飽和、軌道突然失控；地面傾斜改變光束線與光源的相對角度時，即使電子軌道被修正，樣品上的光點仍會漂移。~Relying only on orbit feedback without ground monitoring lets corrector currents creep to the end of their range over months until feedback saturates and the orbit suddenly escapes; floor tilt that changes the beamline-to-source angle makes the spot on the sample drift even when the electron orbit is corrected.
units.misconception: 軌道回授可以補償任何地面變形，因此不必監測地層。~Orbit feedback compensates any ground motion, so ground monitoring is unnecessary.

units.anchor: U9、U5 與 EPU5.6 波盪器~U9, U5 and EPU5.6 undulators
units.title: 軟 X 光波盪器與光子能量涵蓋~Soft-X-ray undulators and photon-energy coverage
units.mechanism: 1.5 GeV 的 TLS 在真空紫外到軟 X 光波段特別有效率：週期 9 cm 的 U9、5 cm 的 U5 與可變偏振的 EPU5.6 等波盪器，把基頻放在數十到數百 eV。波盪器光子能量隨 E² 標度，同一支波盪器搬到 3 GeV 的 TPS，能量會提高 4 倍。偶極光源的 2.14 keV 臨界能量涵蓋到數 keV，更硬的 X 光則交給超導扭擺器。因此 TLS 的光束線以軟 X 光、紅外與成熟的常規技術為主，與 TPS 的硬 X 光高亮度定位互補。~The 1.5 GeV TLS is especially efficient from the vacuum ultraviolet to soft X-rays: undulators such as U9 with a 9 cm period, U5 with 5 cm and the variable-polarization EPU5.6 put their fundamentals at tens to hundreds of eV. Undulator photon energy scales as E², so the same device moved to 3 GeV TPS would give four times the energy. The 2.14 keV bending-magnet critical energy covers up to a few keV, and harder X-rays come from the superconducting wigglers. TLS beamlines therefore focus on soft X-rays, infrared and mature routine techniques, complementing the hard-X-ray, high-brightness role of TPS.
units.model: 波盪器基頻能量為 E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2))。U9 在 1.5 GeV、K = 1：E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV；K = 3：≈ 43 eV；同一支 U9 在 3 GeV（K = 1）≈ 633 eV。若要以 1.5 GeV 在 K = 1 得到 10 keV 基頻，λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm，即 1.4 mm 週期，遠低於永久磁鐵波盪器的實用範圍。~The undulator fundamental is E₁[keV] = 0.950E²/(λu[cm](1 + K²/2)). U9 at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 gives E₁ = 0.950×2.25/(9×1.5) ≈ 158 eV, and K = 3 gives ≈ 43 eV; the same U9 at 3 GeV (K = 1) gives ≈ 633 eV. A 10 keV fundamental at 1.5 GeV with K = 1 would need λu ≈ 0.950×2.25/(10×1.5) ≈ 0.14 cm, a 1.4 mm period, far below the practical range of permanent-magnet undulators.
units.verify: 以光束線單色器掃描波盪器頻譜，量測基頻與高次諧波峰值能量對間隙的關係並與公式比較；EPU 改變相位時以偏振計量測圓偏振度；記錄間隙或相位改變時的軌道與工作點擾動，建立並定期更新前饋修正表。~Scan the undulator spectrum with the beamline monochromator and compare fundamental and harmonic peak energies versus gap with the formula; measure the degree of circular polarization with a polarimeter as the EPU phase changes; record orbit and tune disturbances as gap or phase changes to build and periodically refresh the feedforward table.
units.failure: 波盪器磁鐵的相位誤差累積使高次諧波強度大幅下降，用戶在預期能量找不到足夠通量；EPU 切換偏振模式時若前饋表過期，軌道擾動傳到其他光束線，造成全環強度跳動。~Accumulated phase errors in the undulator magnets sharply weaken the higher harmonics, so users find too little flux at the expected energy; switching EPU polarization with an outdated feedforward table spreads orbit disturbances to other beamlines and makes intensity jump around the ring.
units.misconception: 低能量環的波盪器也能輕易產生 10 keV 以上的基頻 X 光。~An undulator on a low-energy ring can just as easily produce a fundamental above 10 keV.

units.anchor: TLS 與 TPS 的雙光源分工~Dual-source division between TLS and TPS
units.title: 與 TPS 並行運轉的分工、相干度與交接~Running alongside TPS: division of labour, coherence and handoff
units.mechanism: TPS 開放用戶後，TLS 並未退役，而是與 TPS 一起由 NSRRC 營運：TLS 提供 22 條光束線、約 50 個實驗站，偏重軟 X 光、紅外與成熟技術，TPS 承擔需要低發射度與高亮度的實驗。決定實驗留在哪座光源的工程依據之一是相干分率：當電子發射度遠大於光子繞射極限 λ/4π 時，相干光比例很低。交接需記錄每條光束線的光源參數、可用度與老化設備的維護計畫，避免兩座光源共用的人力、低溫與電力資源互相排擠。~After TPS opened to users, TLS was not retired; NSRRC operates both: TLS provides 22 beamlines with about 50 end stations focused on soft X-rays, infrared and mature techniques, while TPS takes experiments needing low emittance and high brightness. One engineering criterion for which source hosts an experiment is the coherent fraction: when electron emittance far exceeds the photon diffraction limit λ/4π, little of the light is coherent. The handoff must record source parameters, availability and maintenance plans for ageing equipment on every beamline so that staff, cryogenics and electrical power shared by the two sources do not crowd each other out.
units.model: 繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/4π。100 eV（λ = 12.4 nm）：ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm；水平相干分率約 ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)，TLS（25.6 nm）≈ 3.7%，TPS（1.6 nm）≈ 38%。10 keV（λ = 0.124 nm）：ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm，TLS ≈ 0.04%、TPS ≈ 0.6%。TLS 垂直發射度 88 pm 在 100 eV 已低於 ε_r，故軟 X 光在垂直方向接近全相干。~The diffraction-limited emittance is ε_r = λ/4π. At 100 eV (λ = 12.4 nm), ε_r ≈ 0.99 nm and the horizontal coherent fraction is about ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r): TLS (25.6 nm) ≈ 3.7% and TPS (1.6 nm) ≈ 38%. At 10 keV (λ = 0.124 nm), ε_r ≈ 9.9 pm, TLS ≈ 0.04% and TPS ≈ 0.6%. The TLS vertical emittance of 88 pm is already below ε_r at 100 eV, so soft X-rays are nearly fully coherent vertically.
units.verify: 每年以兩座光源的實際運轉參數（電流、發射度、可用度、故障停機時數）建立對照表；以光束線的狹縫干涉或空間相干量測驗證相干分率估算；把老化元件（電源、真空泵、低溫系統）的更換紀錄與故障率趨勢納入交接文件。~Each year tabulate the actual operating parameters of both sources (current, emittance, availability, fault downtime); verify coherent-fraction estimates with slit-interference or spatial-coherence measurements on beamlines; include replacement records and failure-rate trends of ageing components (power supplies, vacuum pumps, cryogenics) in the handoff documents.
units.failure: 若把需要高相干度的實驗排到 TLS，只能用小孔徑濾出相干光，通量損失數十倍，實驗時間膨脹；若 TLS 的維護因資源轉向 TPS 而延後，老化電源與真空設備的故障率上升，22 條光束線的可用度一起下降。~Scheduling a coherence-hungry experiment on TLS forces small apertures to filter coherent light, losing tens of times in flux and inflating beam time; deferring TLS maintenance as resources shift to TPS raises failure rates of ageing power supplies and vacuum equipment, and availability drops across all 22 beamlines.
units.misconception: TPS 完工後 TLS 就失去用處，應該立即停機。~Once TPS operated, TLS became useless and should have shut down at once.

example: 能量提升練習：TLS 由 1.3 GeV 提升到 1.5 GeV（ρ = 3.495 m 不變）。B 由 1.24 T 升到 1.43 T；E_c = 2.218E³/ρ 由 1.39 keV 升到 2.14 keV；U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ 由 72 keV 升到 128 keV，300 mA 時偶極輻射功率由 21.7 kW 升到 38.4 kW。8 keV 光子的偶極通量 dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y)（photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW），y = 8/E_c：1.3 GeV 時 y = 5.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0108，通量 ≈ 1.0×10¹¹；1.5 GeV 時 y = 3.74、G₁ ≈ 0.0670，通量 ≈ 7.4×10¹¹，能量只提高 15%，8 keV 通量卻提高約 7.2 倍。代價是發射度按 E² 由 19.2 增為 25.6 nm·rad，而水平阻尼時間 τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ 由 14.4 ms 縮短為 9.4 ms。數值依公開參數與教學假設計算，不代表實際運轉紀錄。~Energy-upgrade exercise: TLS goes from 1.3 GeV to 1.5 GeV with ρ = 3.495 m unchanged. B rises from 1.24 T to 1.43 T; E_c = 2.218E³/ρ from 1.39 keV to 2.14 keV; U₀ = 88.46E⁴/ρ from 72 keV to 128 keV, so dipole radiation at 300 mA grows from 21.7 kW to 38.4 kW. Bending-magnet flux at 8 keV is dN/dθ = 2.457×10¹³·E·I·G₁(y) photons/s/mrad/0.1%BW with y = 8/E_c: at 1.3 GeV, y = 5.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0108 and the flux ≈ 1.0×10¹¹; at 1.5 GeV, y = 3.74, G₁ ≈ 0.0670 and the flux ≈ 7.4×10¹¹, so a 15% energy increase raises 8 keV flux about 7.2 times. The price is emittance growing as E² from 19.2 to 25.6 nm·rad, while the horizontal damping time τ_x = 2ET₀/U₀ shortens from 14.4 ms to 9.4 ms. Numbers follow public parameters and teaching assumptions, not operating records.
history: TLS 由同步輻射研究中心（今國家同步輻射研究中心）在新竹科學園區興建，1993 年 4 月首次儲存電子束，同年 10 月開放用戶，是亞洲第一座、全球第三座第三代同步輻射光源。1996 年運轉能量由 1.3 GeV 提升到 1.5 GeV，2000 年改為全能量增能環注入，2002 年 6 T 超導波長位移器投入運轉，2005 年 2 月超導射頻腔例行運轉、10 月起實施頂注；TPS 開放後兩座光源並行服務用戶。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~TLS was built in Hsinchu Science Park by the Synchrotron Radiation Research Center, now the National Synchrotron Radiation Research Center; it first stored beam in April 1993 and opened to users that October as Asia's first and the world's third third-generation synchrotron light source. Operating energy rose from 1.3 to 1.5 GeV in 1996, full-energy booster injection followed in 2000, the 6 T superconducting wavelength shifter entered operation in 2002, and in 2005 the SRF cavity went into routine use in February and top-up began in October; since TPS opened, the two sources have served users side by side. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
